description: This file defines the `Conf` class, responsible for managing and retrieving database configuration settings within the OrangeHRM system. It resolves configuration parameters from environment variables, applying defaults and adjusting database name prefixing in test environments.

classes.name: Conf
classes.description: A class that handles database configuration, resolving settings from environment variables with fallback defaults and accommodating test environment prefixes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes database configuration settings from environment variables, with defaults and environment-specific modifications.

methods.name: getDbName
methods.description: Returns the database name, including test prefix if applicable.
